title: A big ruby from a Chest
description: The player opens a chest on a high ledge of the Tutorial. An emerald, a sapphire, a ruby and a big ruby spill out around his feet. He stands among them, collecting nothing, until 20 steps later he takes the big ruby and walks off; the small ruby, which fell off the ledge, he collects below.
